levels.surface: محمد بن عمر بن محمد بن سلم بنالبراء الجعابي
أبو محمد الحسن بن عبد الله بن محمد بن العباس الرازي التميمي

notes: «بِهذَا الإِسناد» opens the report: prev1 to prev7 open with a back reference and write no chain; prev8 (214) is the nearest report that writes its chain, so its names are taken over in order as inherited items, and no back_reference is written
the report's own text adds no link: «قالَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ» ends the chain at the Prophet, and Ali b. Abi Talib is the last link
«سيدي» before «علي بن موسى الرضا» is an honorific and is left out; «أبي» before each name is a bare relation whose name stands alone (rule 7)
two consecutive «الحسين بن علي» each have their own «حدثني أبي», so they are kept as two links, as written (rule 7 counter-example)
